text:
mira (PM): quick sync — digging into Q3 roadmap for devex. want to lock SDK + sample-app scope today.

kevin (devex): +1. goal: ship GA JS + python SDKs, 3 quickstarts (chat, embeddings, reranker), and two end-to-end sample apps.

alex (eng): timeline? we only have two core eng sprints before end of quarter.

mira (PM): timeline proposal: M1: stabilize core SDK APIs + auth; M2: quickstarts & sample apps; M3: docs polish + perf tests. target GA end of quarter.

sam (docs): for GA we need: 1) tutorial for each quickstart, 2) API reference auto-generated, 3) migration guide from old SDK. can we commit to generated docs by M2?

olivia (solutions): customers repeatedly ask for a sample app showing streaming + function-calling in a product flow. can we prioritize one commerce and one internal-search sample?

kevin (devex): agree on the two samples. propose minimal scope: commerce demo = checkout assistant (streaming chat + payment callout stub); search demo = rerank + embeddings pipeline. both runnable with docker-compose.

alex (eng): implementation notes: streaming + tool-calls will need runtime support toggles. we should depend on runtime flag: RB_ENABLE_STREAMING=true. add to docker compose example.

sam (docs): example install/run snippet for sample apps:

```
npm install @redwood/inference-sdk
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx
node samples/commerce/start.js
```

kevin (devex): launch criteria suggestion (GA):
- SDKs: stable public surface + 80% unit coverage on exposed helpers
- Quickstarts: 3 tutorials with runnable code and CI smoke tests
- Samples: 2 apps with local run instructions and perf checklist
- Docs: reference + migration + 1-page troubleshooting
- Telemetry: opt-in usage metrics + error reporting

mira (PM): pragmatic: can we relax unit coverage to 60% for GA if we have integration smoke tests? customers care that things run end-to-end.

alex (eng): fine with 60% unit if we include CI smoke and a perf benchmark (latency < 200ms median for local small model).

olivia (solutions): also need a short runbook for support: typical errors, env var checklist, and how to toggle dedicated vs hosted. I can draft.

sam (docs): will create template docs and checklist: "GA Readiness" with tickboxes. will PR to docs repo.

kevin (devex): owners: SDK eng = alex, quickstarts = kevin + sam, samples = olivia + alex. deadlines: feature freeze in 3 weeks (1772360000), docs freeze 1 week after.

mira (PM): assign in Asana and ping leads. small negotiation: if streaming blocks progress we ship non-streaming GA with a clearly advertised caveat.

alex (eng): agree. fallback plan accepted.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch devex/roadmap-mvp — status: pending (CI).

kevin (devex): open questions: multi-language beyond python/js (go/java) — push to FYQ4. we need telemetry + SDK metrics across languages first.

mira (PM): final decision: GA = JS + Python only. Go/Java in backlog for FYQ4.

sam (docs): I'll add a short FAQ: "when will other languages be supported" and link to roadmap ticket.

olivia (solutions): can we get a customer review board sample before GA for feedback? I'll set up 2 early access customers.

mira (PM): perfect — action items recap in thread:
- alex: implement core auth + streaming flag, perf benchmark (due 1772352000)
- kevin + sam: quickstarts + docs templates (due 1772355600)
- olivia: sample apps + customer review board (due 1772355600)
- sam: PR GA Readiness checklist (due 1772352000)

kevin (devex): noted. I'll create the tickets and link them here. :thumbsup:

mira (PM): thanks all — short follow-up tomorrow 10am PT.

alex (eng): 10am PT works.

sam (docs): thanks!

olivia (solutions): ttyl :rocket:
